name: Rose Window
description: A cathedral in your pocket: the great ideas, prayer, music, art and poetry of the Christian tradition, and a church near you, in a few minutes a day.

features.note: askEndpoint is the relay's address. With it set, the daily-email sign-up works. Each feature here also needs its own setup on the relay (see agents/README.md) before you switch it on.

analytics.note: Plausible (or a compatible, cookie-free host). Set plausible to the domain you added in Plausible. Events are listed in LAUNCH.md. Staging never counts.

legal.note: Required for the Imprint (Impressum) and Privacy pages: your full name, a postal address where you can be reached, and an email address.
